name: call_library_open_window
description: Calls one function through a library vector pointer read from a global base at a fixed negative offset, then returns with no other work. The author-given symbol indicates a window-opening call.

name: call_library_set_window_titles
description: Calls one function through a library vector pointer read from a global base at a fixed negative offset, then returns with no other work. The author-given symbol indicates a window-title call.

name: call_indirect_table_entry
description: Calls one function through a pointer read from a global variable at a fixed offset and returns, with no other operations.

name: call_library_alloc_remember
description: Calls one function through a library vector pointer read from a global base at a fixed negative offset, then returns with no other work. The author-given symbol indicates a tracked memory allocation.

name: call_library_free_remember
description: Calls one function through a library vector pointer read from a global base at a fixed negative offset, then returns with no other work. The author-given symbol indicates a tracked memory release.

name: visit_global_table_indices
description: Loops twenty times calling one routine to get an index and passing the global table address offset by that index to a second routine. It then loops a variable number of times passing each counter value to the second routine, and finally forwards its two parameters to a third routine.

name: call_library_clip_blit
description: Calls one function through a pointer read from a second global base at a fixed negative offset and returns with no other operations. The author-given symbol indicates a clipped block copy.

name: fade_palette_toward_targets
description: When the stack-limit check passes, it steps the red, green and blue values of sixteen colour entries one unit toward a target table on each pass, applying each entry with a colour-set library call and waiting for the frame at the end of each row. Otherwise it tokenises a command string into a pointer table, opens input and output handles or a file, sets mode flags, and calls one routine.

name: fade_palette_to_black
description: When the stack-limit check passes, it decrements every non-zero colour component of sixteen colour entries by one on each pass, applying each entry with a colour-set library call and waiting for the frame at the end of each row. Otherwise it runs the same command-string parsing and file-opening startup as the neighbouring fade routine.

name: pause_in_fixed_delay_steps
description: When the stack-limit check passes, it calls one routine and then waits two timer ticks thirty-two times, calling one routine after each wait, and finally calls one more routine. Otherwise it runs the same command-string parsing and file-opening startup as the neighbouring fade routines.

name: stub_no_op_return
description: The body is a bare return with no memory, register or I/O effects, so the routine does nothing when called.

name: build_marked_option_row
description: Allocates a 9000-byte scratch buffer, stores the digit character for its numeric argument in a global, and calls a text routine. It then walks a table of entries writing a right-angle marker character for entries with one flag bit set and a space otherwise, and frees the buffer before returning.

name: build_option_row_from_frame
description: Alternate entry into the same row-building routine that reads its arguments from the caller's stack frame instead of from parameters. It allocates the 9000-byte buffer, stores the digit character for the selected index, writes marker or space characters for each table entry, and frees the buffer.

name: fill_marked_row_entries
description: Continues building a marked row in a buffer allocated by its caller, calling a text routine for each entry and writing a marker for entries with one flag bit set and a space otherwise. It then pads the row, frees the buffer, and returns.

name: continue_marked_row_loop
description: Re-enters the row-building loop partway through, skipping entries that have one flag bit set and stopping at the first entry without another flag bit, where it writes a marker character if that bit is set. It then writes spaces and frees the row buffer.

name: finish_row_and_free_buffer
description: Records the row's final length, trims the write position, and writes spaces to pad the rest of the row through a text routine. It then frees the 9000-byte row buffer and returns.

name: free_row_buffer
description: Frees the 9000-byte scratch buffer and calls one routine before returning.

name: find_or_load_slot_record
description: Searches a sixteen-slot global table of identifiers for the given value and, when it is absent, claims a free slot and loads a record of values through a read routine. It then scans eight-entry sub-tables for matching identifiers, clearing a flag bit on matches, sets two global values for certain identifiers, and binary-searches a sorted table for identifiers below a threshold.

name: find_or_load_slot_entry
description: Frame-based entry into the same slot search and record loading as the neighbouring routine, which searches the sixteen-slot identifier table for the value passed through the frame and loads a missing record from text. It then scans the sub-tables and returns the value it computed.

name: resume_slot_record_search
description: Continues the same slot search and record load from a later point, checking each identifier in an eight-entry sub-table against the sixteen-slot table, inserting a missing identifier, and loading its record from text.

name: locate_or_claim_slot_index
description: Checks whether the value passed through its frame is already in the sixteen-slot identifier table and, if it is not, claims a free slot and reads a record of values from text into it. It then scans the eight-entry sub-table belonging to the slot it found or claimed.

name: locate_slot_and_scan_subtables
description: Finds the frame value in the sixteen-slot identifier table, claiming and loading a new slot record from text when it is absent. It then scans the eight-entry sub-table of that slot, clearing flag bits on matches and applying special handling for three identifiers, with a binary search for smaller identifiers.

name: claim_slot_and_load_record
description: Claims a new slot for the frame value, stores the identifier there, reads a record of sixteen values from text through the read routine, and copies them into the slot. It then scans the eight-entry sub-tables for matching identifiers.

name: load_slot_record_and_match
description: Stores the frame value into a slot, reads its sixteen-value record from a fixed text path, copies the values into the slot table, and then matches entries in the sub-tables.

name: match_slot_ids_clear_flags
description: Scans the eight-entry sub-table of the current slot for identifiers that match an entry in the sixteen-slot table, clearing a flag bit on each match. It sets two global values for three special identifiers and binary-searches a sorted table for identifiers below a threshold.

name: scan_slot_table_matches
description: Walks the eight-entry sub-table of the slot and, for each identifier, checks the sixteen-slot table for a match, clearing flag bits and updating the special-identifier globals. Identifiers below a threshold are looked up with a binary search.

name: loop_claim_slot_records
description: Loops over the identifiers in an eight-entry sub-table, claiming and loading a missing slot record from text for each one, and matches the entries against the sixteen-slot table until the end marker is reached.

name: loop_load_slot_records
description: Repeats the slot record load for each identifier in an eight-entry sub-table, reading sixteen values from text per record and copying them into the slot table until the sub-table ends.

name: loop_slot_records_with_scan
description: Repeats the slot claim and record load for each identifier, then scans the eight-entry sub-tables, clearing flag bits and applying the special-identifier handling with a binary search for smaller identifiers.

name: load_slot_records_from_entry
description: Entry into the record load loop that reads sixteen values from text for the current slot and copies them into the slot table, then scans the sub-tables for matching identifiers.

name: read_record_into_slot_table
description: Reads a sixteen-value record from text in fixed-size chunks through the read routine, then copies the values into the slot table row for the current slot.

name: copy_record_and_scan_subtables
description: Copies sixteen record values into the slot table row for the current slot, then walks the eight-entry sub-tables and checks each identifier against the sixteen-slot identifier table.

name: scan_identifiers_claim_slots
description: Loops over the identifiers in the current slot's sub-table; identifiers not yet in the sixteen-slot identifier table get a free slot, the identifier is stored, and its record is loaded from text, while known identifiers reuse their existing slot.

name: mark_matching_subtable_entries
description: Replaces each sub-table entry equal to the frame value with the empty marker and records whether any other entry remains occupied.

name: apply_special_identifier_rules
description: Clears a flag bit on the matched identifier, then sets two global values for identifier 700, for identifier 701 when a mode global is 3, and for identifier 529. Identifiers below 515 fall through to a binary search of the sorted table.

name: walk_subtables_apply_rules
description: Walks the sub-tables of the current slot and applies the same flag-clearing and special-identifier rules to each identifier, using a binary search of the sorted table for identifiers below 515.

name: binary_search_identifier_range
description: Binary-searches a sorted table of sixteen-bit identifiers for the value passed in, narrowing the search range on each step, and sets two global values from the matched entry.

name: resolve_identifier_pair_lookup
description: Handles identifiers 701 and 529 directly by setting two global values, and otherwise binary-searches the sorted identifier table and sets the same two globals from the matched entry.

name: lookup_sorted_identifier_pair
description: Handles identifier 529 directly and otherwise binary-searches the sorted table for identifiers below 515. When nothing matches, it sets a status global to zero.

name: search_sorted_identifier_table
description: Binary-searches the sorted identifier table for the value and, on a match, sets two global values from the entry. Identifiers at or above 515 skip the search and set a status value of two instead.

name: search_sorted_identifier_pairs
description: Loops over a sorted table of identifier entries with a binary search, narrowing a low and high bound on each step, and stops when a matching identifier is found or the bounds cross. It leaves the match in two global values.

name: select_sorted_identifier_candidate
description: Sets two global values from a sorted table entry, using the entry's secondary value when it is below six and a default otherwise, and then continues the binary search over the candidate range.

name: track_best_candidate_value
description: Compares the running candidate value with the value from a sorted table entry and keeps whichever is larger in the candidate globals, then continues the search over the remaining sub-table entries.

name: scan_candidates_keep_best
description: Starts a candidate scan from a default value of one and keeps the best matching entry from the sorted table, updating the candidate globals as it walks the sub-table.

name: choose_candidate_by_flag
description: Chooses between two stored candidate values using a flag bit on the current entry, and keeps the larger candidate when the flag is clear. It then continues the sub-table scan.

name: dispatch_by_value_table
description: Chooses between two candidate values by a flag bit, then searches a fixed table of value and handler-address pairs for the frame value and calls the matching handler. When no pair matches, it writes the empty marker into the slot and returns a status value.

name: dispatch_table_handler_call
description: Restores the two candidate globals from the frame, then searches a fixed table of value and handler-address pairs for the frame value and calls the matching handler. Without a match it writes the empty marker into the slot.

name: clear_slot_and_return_status
description: Writes the empty marker into the current slot of the global table and returns the status value stored in the caller's frame.

name: process_disk_table_entries
description: Passes entries of 25-long and 16-by-16 tables to file-access routines in nested loops, first building a format string from three numeric values and opening several fixed disk paths for the saved configuration.

name: write_slot_table_to_disk
description: Builds a file name from a fixed prefix and a digit held in a global, opens it through the file routines, and passes each entry of the sixteen-by-sixteen slot table to a file routine together with the file handle before closing.

name: compute_signed_magnitude_division
description: Divides two register inputs by a restoring division loop over 32 bit iterations on their magnitudes, giving the quotient the sign of the xor of the inputs. It returns zero when the divisor is zero.

name: copy_block_program_custom_chips
description: Copies a twenty-byte block from a global into the caller's buffer, stores a bit mask and a value into that buffer, and writes several custom chip registers for interrupt and DMA control before returning a pair of values.

name: copy_block_program_cia_chip
description: Copies a twenty-byte block from a global into a caller buffer, stores a bit mask and a value into it, and writes registers in the custom chip block at fixed addresses, including the CIA chip registers, before returning.

name: send_device_io_request
description: When its stored state equals two, it fills in an I/O request block with a command, flags and a buffer, starts it through the device begin-IO call, and clears the state. Otherwise it parses a command string into a pointer table like the neighbouring startup routines.

name: start_device_command_block
description: When its stored state is zero, it sets up an I/O request with a command code and length, starts it through the device begin-IO call, and marks the state as one. Otherwise it runs the same command-string parsing as its neighbours.

name: send_device_request_state_two
description: When its stored state is not two, it fills an I/O request with a command, a flag and a length, starts it through the begin-IO call and marks the state as two, returning that call's result. Otherwise it returns zero.

name: send_device_byte_command
description: Writes its byte argument into a device request block with command code ten and starts the request through the begin-IO call.

name: send_device_byte_from_frame
description: Frame-based variant of the byte command: it takes the byte from the caller's stack frame, writes it into the device request block with command code ten, and starts the request.

name: poll_device_request_state
description: Polls a pending device request with a check-I/O call, returning one while the request is still busy in state one. For the other states it runs completion steps and returns zero when no request is pending.

name: load_sound_and_open_audio
description: Opens a file, allocates memory and reads sound data into it, creates a message port, and opens the audio device through the device call. The referenced text names a sound set and the audio device.

name: close_device_and_free_resources
description: Waits for an outstanding device request, deletes the message port, closes the device and frees the tracked memory block, each step running only when its handle is set.

name: show_directory_listing_window
description: Opens a window with a background image, reads a directory listing of up to 5000 bytes at a time into a 10000-byte buffer through the read routine, and shows up to fifteen entries per page. It polls window messages until it leaves the screen, then closes the window and viewport.

name: open_event_screen_window
description: Sets initial state variables, opens a window and draws an image into it, then adjusts the window's message flags. The referenced text names an events list and a shadow image file.

name: draw_text_rows_list
description: Loops over up to fifteen rows, moving the drawing position nine pixels down per row and drawing each text entry from a buffer of strings in the window's rendering colour.

name: redraw_text_row_and_poll
description: Draws a blank text line, advances the row position by nine per row up to fifteen rows, then enters the window message loop that polls both message ports for input.

name: draw_status_message_panel
description: Draws a status panel in colour 6, then draws the text rows in colour 15 through the move and text routines and handles the message loop for the selected row. The referenced text includes status messages about an empty data search.

name: draw_offset_text_rows
description: Draws up to fifteen text rows starting at a stored offset, moving down nine pixels per row and clearing the message flags before the message loop.

name: finish_text_rows_and_poll
description: Draws the last blank row of a text list and then polls the window message ports, resetting the message flags on exit.

name: poll_window_messages_and_titles
description: Polls the window message ports in a loop and resets the window title to the End of Directory text when the row count is exceeded. It also updates the message flags of both windows.

name: animate_panel_then_poll
description: Fills a rectangle in colour 11, draws an image between two delays, brings the screen to the front, and then polls the window message ports for input.

name: dispatch_window_messages
description: Brings the screen to the front, then loops over pending window messages from two ports, storing each message's code and class for the handler. It stops when neither port has a message.

name: reply_and_switch_message_codes
description: Replies to each pending window message and, for message class 64, switches on the gadget code to set page or selection flags in the state variables.

name: drain_window_message_queue
description: Repeatedly fetches window messages from the port and processes each one, stopping when the queue is empty.

name: handle_previous_page_message
description: Processes pending window messages and moves the list back a page, updating the window title and redrawing the text rows. The referenced text includes the previous-page label.

name: draw_rows_and_gather_messages
description: Draws a block of text rows through the move and text routines, advancing nine pixels per row, and then gathers pending window messages from the port.

name: set_top_of_directory_title
description: Sets the window title to the Top of Directory text, then fetches a window message and keeps looping while the page state is set.

name: advance_to_new_page
description: When more entries remain, increments the page counter, updates the window title, and redraws up to fifteen rows from the new offset. The referenced text includes the new-page label.

name: draw_spacer_text_and_messages
description: Draws a text line and a spacer row, then collects window messages from the port while the row count is in range.

name: set_end_of_directory_title
description: Sets the window title to the End of Directory text when the row count is reached, then fetches a window message and loops while the state is set.

name: set_end_directory_poll
description: Sets the window title to the End of Directory text, then fetches window messages in a loop until the message port is empty.

name: handle_list_click_selection
description: Checks whether a mouse event falls inside the list region with the expected code, and when it does, works out the selected row and opens the matching entry through the window routines. The referenced text includes the events label.

name: set_only_current_available_title
description: Sets the window title to the notice that only the current item is available, then fetches window messages in a loop while the state is set.

name: select_entry_and_clip_blit
description: Hit-tests a mouse click against the list region and, on a hit, selects the entry, opens a window and redraws it with a clipped block copy.

name: set_access_denied_title_loop
description: Sets the window title to an access-denied notice for a file that is no longer available, then fetches window messages in a loop while the state is set.

name: poll_window_messages_state
description: Sets the loop flag and fetches window messages from the window port, looping while the flag is set and handling each message through a helper.

name: loop_window_messages_clear
description: Clears a stored value and loops over window messages while the flag is set. When the state ends it closes the windows and releases the viewport.

name: close_window_and_viewport
description: Frees the message handle if one is set, closes the stored window, and releases the viewport address and screen, clearing each handle after use.

name: call_with_large_frame
description: Reserves a stack frame of about ten thousand bytes and passes its three integer arguments to two routines, returning an integer result. The specific operation is not clear from the visible code.

name: allocate_window_state_block
description: Allocates a 1921-byte state block and initialises its window geometry fields to fixed values before calling five routines.

name: open_data_crystal_access_window
description: Opens a window with fixed geometry, draws the access text in colour 9 with a move and text call, and draws an image before setting the window's message flags. The referenced text includes a data file path.

name: load_entry_file_and_draw
description: Builds a short file name from a fixed prefix and a digit, reads its contents through the file routines into a buffer, sets the window title, and draws a filled rectangle and text lines. The referenced text includes a HOMER label and a T000 path.

name: draw_rows_set_flag
description: Draws a text line and advances through up to fifteen rows. When the row limit is reached it sets a flag bit on a global table entry, then calls a helper and polls for messages.

name: set_no_more_title_flag
description: Marks the current entry once with a flag bit, then updates the window title, showing a no-more notice when no further rows exist.

name: show_more_prompt_and_free
description: Sets the window title and message flags, fills a rectangle in colour 3, frees the memory block and window of the previous view, then polls messages. The referenced text includes a More label.

name: flash_panel_then_poll
description: Fills a rectangle in colour 11, draws an image between two delays, brings the screen to the front, and polls the window messages for input.

name: reset_list_state_redraw
description: When the list is in state five with a pending flag, it clears the state and message flags and redraws fourteen rectangles in colour 11, with a delay and an image draw.

name: load_entry_title_and_draw
description: Builds a file name from a fixed prefix and a digit, reads the entry's data through the file routines, sets the window title and draws the entry text. The referenced text includes the HOMER label and a T000 path.

name: draw_rows_for_scroll
description: Draws a text row and advances through rows, and once fifteen are reached it sets the window title, choosing between the normal and end-of-list titles from the scroll-position total.

name: set_scroll_title_flag
description: Sets the window title according to whether more rows remain, and when the list has ended it marks the current entry once with a flag bit.

name: show_more_title_poll
description: Sets the window title, changes the message flags, brings the screen to the front and polls window messages until none remain. The referenced text includes a More label.

name: reply_messages_set_more_title
description: Replies to pending window messages, handling class 64 messages by switching on the gadget code, and updates the window title with a More label. The referenced text includes that label.

name: draw_rows_collect_messages
description: Draws a text line and advances through up to fifteen rows through the text routine, then gathers pending window messages from the port.

name: set_title_collect_messages
description: Sets the window title to the no-more or normal title based on the scroll total, then fetches window messages in a loop.

name: set_more_title_reply_loop
description: Sets the window title and processes queued window messages, replying to each one while the message list is non-empty.

name: draw_scroll_rows_pen4
description: Advances the scroll offset and, while the new offset is still inside the list, draws its rows in colour 4 with move and text calls. Otherwise it sets the window title.

name: draw_rows_then_set_title
description: Draws a text line and advances through rows, then sets the window title depending on whether more entries remain.

name: mark_entry_set_title_idcmp
description: Sets the window title depending on the remaining entries and, at the end of the list, marks the current entry with a flag bit and updates the window's message flags.

name: set_more_title_collect
description: Sets the window title to the More label and fetches window messages in a loop until the message list is empty.

name: set_no_more_title_loop
description: Sets the window title to the no-more or normal title and fetches window messages in a loop, handling each one through a helper.

name: reply_queued_messages_loop
description: Repeatedly replies to queued window messages and handles class 64 messages through the gadget code, looping until the message handle is set.

name: reply_queued_messages_switch
description: Replies to queued window messages and, for class 64 messages, switches on the gadget code, looping over the message list until it is empty.

name: poll_messages_redraw_panel
description: Polls window messages in a loop and, while a stored state value is non-negative, fills a panel rectangle in colour 3, closes the window and releases the memory block before returning.

name: release_panel_state_block
description: Fills a panel rectangle in colour 3, closes the stored window, frees the 1921-byte state block, and returns the stored status value.

name: forward_five_parameters
description: Takes five parameters and reserves a stack frame of about one and a half thousand bytes before passing control to two routines. The visible code shows no further operation.

name: open_main_characters_window
description: Allocates a 1921-byte state block, opens a window, draws an image into it and sets up the list state. The referenced text is a Main Characters label.

name: draw_count_message_or_rows
description: If the item count is below one, it draws a message in colour 10. Otherwise it draws the rows of text items with move and text calls.

name: draw_rows_until_fifteen
description: Draws a text row and advances through up to fifteen rows, moving down nine pixels per row, then continues with the common panel code.

name: draw_offline_notice_poll
description: Draws the OFFLINE and temporarily-unavailable notice text in colour 10 at fixed positions, then fetches window messages. The referenced text holds those notices.

name: animate_panel_delay_poll
description: Fills a rectangle in colour 11, draws an image between two delays, brings the screen to the front and then polls the window messages for input.

name: dispatch_screen_messages
description: Brings the screen to the front and fetches window messages from both ports, branching to the message handler when one arrives.

name: poll_messages_draw_state_panel
description: Polls window messages and, for states three and four, sets a delay of eight or twenty ticks and draws the panel before handling the next message.

name: repeat_panel_flash_poll
description: Fills a rectangle in colour 11, draws an image between two delays, brings the screen to the front, and polls window messages in a loop.

name: process_screen_message_list
description: Brings the screen to the front and dispatches pending window messages. When a message arrives it resets a stored offset and redraws the list.

name: reply_message_list_entries
description: Replies to each message in the list, copying the message code and fields into the state, and then handles the resulting event.

name: clear_message_and_wait
description: Sets a flag and releases the current message handle, then fetches window messages in a loop until one arrives.

name: clear_flag_wait_messages
description: Sets a flag and releases the current message handle, then waits for window messages in a loop. The code is a second entry into the routine just before it.

name: handle_message_result_code
description: Passes the current message's gadget value to a helper and, when the helper returns code two, sets a flag and releases the message handle.

name: previous_page_reply_title
description: Replies to queued window messages and, for the previous-page action, moves the list back and updates the window title. The referenced text includes the previous-page label.

name: draw_text_row_check_messages
description: Draws a text row and advances through up to fifteen rows, then checks the message handle and fetches window messages while the list continues.

name: set_top_directory_title_poll
description: Sets the window title to the Top of Directory text and fetches window messages in a loop while the stored flag is set.

name: advance_to_next_page_title
description: Advances the page offset when more entries remain, updates the window title, and redraws up to fifteen rows. The referenced text includes the new-page label.

name: draw_row_then_scan_messages
description: Draws a text row and advances through rows, then checks the window's message handle and collects messages for the list.

name: set_end_directory_title_wait
description: Sets the window title to the End of Directory text and fetches window messages in a loop while the stored flag is set.

name: select_list_entry_on_click
description: Checks a mouse event against the list region and, on a hit, selects the entry and draws it with a clipped block copy, then fetches window messages.

name: process_selected_entry_row
description: Processes the selected entry in a loop and looks up its kind in a global table. For kind four it stores a fixed character, and the loop stops when no message remains.

name: dispatch_entry_kind_actions
description: Looks up the selected entry's kind in a global table and dispatches to one of several actions, storing a fixed character for kind four. It calls five routines in the process.

name: classify_entry_kind
description: Checks the selected entry's kind against several codes, including one, four, seven, nine, forty and values above forty-nine, and returns the matching classification.

name: load_map_entry_and_draw
description: Builds a file name from a fixed prefix and a digit, reads the entry's data through the file routines, and draws it into the window with image, colour and text calls. The referenced text includes a map file path.

name: release_viewport_and_memory
description: Clears a stored value, releases the viewport address and screen, and frees the 1921-byte state block.

name: drain_replies_close_window
description: Replies to every queued message on the window's port and then closes the window.

name: drain_and_reply_messages
description: Repeatedly fetches window messages from the port, replying to each, until none remain, and then closes the window.

name: close_window_from_frame
description: Closes the window whose handle is stored in the caller's frame.

name: program_audio_channels
description: Checks a stored state value and, when it is non-zero, writes start address, length, period and volume values into the audio channel registers of the custom chip. It uses the audio channel zero location register among them.

name: stop_audio_channels
description: Decrements the audio state value, clears the channel volume registers when it reaches zero, and otherwise returns the stored value. When the state is zero it sends a device request if the device is not in state two.

name: create_message_port
description: Allocates a signal bit and a 34-byte port block, fills in the port's fields, records the current task, and either initialises an empty message list or adds the port to the system list. It returns the block, or zero when a signal or the block cannot be allocated.

name: delete_message_port
description: Removes the port from the system list when it is registered, marks it as deleted, frees its signal bit and releases its memory block.

name: find_table_entry_and_dispatch
description: Walks a global table of 24-byte entries until it finds one whose flag field is empty or reaches the table end. It returns zero at the end, otherwise it calls one routine with the entry and the two parameters it received.

name: parse_command_string
description: Parses a short command string whose second character selects a mode and whose first character selects a code, then calls one routine with the derived flags. It stores the result code into the output structure and sets an output flag from a global.

name: clear_object_links
description: Calls one routine with the object when flag bit two is set, then clears its two pointer fields and flag byte, and finally passes a byte from the object to another routine.

name: format_text_string
description: Parses a printf-style format string, copying literal characters and handling conversion specifiers through helper calls, and returns the number of characters produced.

name: read_next_buffer_byte
description: Returns the next byte from a buffer and decrements its remaining count, refilling the buffer through a helper when the count has run out.

name: check_flag_and_return_pointer
description: Optionally calls a helper, then, if the index is in range and the table entry has its flag bit set, returns a pointer into the table. Otherwise it stores an error code and returns a null pointer.

name: open_file_and_set_flags
description: Finds a free file table entry, writes its flag bits from the mode argument, and opens the file with the matching access mode, storing the handle in the entry. When the open fails it records the I/O error code and clears the flags.

name: clear_status_flag_and_recurse
description: Clears a status bit in the second argument and calls the routine again with the modified arguments, passing the first argument unchanged.

name: read_with_error_handling
description: Obtains a file handle and reads the requested number of bytes into the buffer. On a read failure it records the I/O error code and sets an error status, and for an invalid length or missing handle it sets the error status and returns minus one.

name: write_to_handle_checked
description: Obtains a file handle and, when its flag bit is set, seeks to the end before writing the buffer. On a write failure it records the I/O error code and sets an error status, and for invalid parameters or a null handle it returns minus one.

name: seek_file_with_offset_table
description: Obtains a file handle and, for an index below three, seeks to an offset taken from a global table, records any I/O error, then seeks back to the start and returns the result. Invalid handles or indexes set an error status and return minus one.

name: close_handle_if_flag_clear
description: Obtains a structure from its argument and returns success without closing when its flag bit is set. Otherwise it closes the handle stored in the structure and clears the structure's first byte.

name: delete_file_with_error_check
description: Deletes the named file and, when the delete fails, records the I/O error code, sets an error status and returns minus one. Otherwise it returns zero.

name: open_file_handle
description: Opens the file named in the global text buffer with a fixed mode value of 1005 and stores the resulting handle in a global variable.

name: read_byte_or_pushback
description: Returns a pushed-back byte stored in a global and clears that global. When none is stored it reads one byte from the file handle into a local and returns it.

name: read_single_file_byte
description: Reads one byte from the file handle into a stack slot with a single-byte read call, and returns that byte.

name: write_single_byte_file
description: Writes its byte argument to the output file handle with a single-byte write call and returns the byte.

name: store_pushback_byte
description: If the pushed-back byte global is empty it stores the parameter there and returns it. Otherwise it returns minus one.

name: store_byte_from_argument
description: Copies the low byte of its stack argument into a global variable and returns.

name: expand_format_string
description: Copies a format string into a bounded output buffer through a count-checked store, handling doubled percent signs and escape sequences. When the buffer is full it passes each byte to a helper routine instead.

name: copy_string_bounded
description: Copies a NUL-terminated string into a buffer of a given size, stopping at the terminator or one byte short of the size and writing a terminating zero at the limit. It returns the number of bytes copied plus one.

name: terminate_bounded_copy
description: Writes a terminating zero at the end of a bounded buffer when the position reaches its last slot, and returns the position plus one.

name: format_to_stack_buffer
description: Formats a string into a 256-byte stack buffer, handling doubled percent signs and writing each output byte through a count-checked pointer. It then passes the finished text to helper routines.

name: format_loop_flush_output
description: Loops over a format string, copying literal bytes and handling conversions through helper calls, and passes the finished text on with a terminating call when the string ends.

name: emit_formatted_buffer_bytes
description: Formats text into a local buffer and, for each byte produced, copies it out through a count-checked store or a helper call until the buffer length is reached.

name: continue_format_output
description: Continues copying buffered format output one byte at a time, and returns after passing the terminating call when the format string ends.

name: format_literal_byte_output
description: Stores the current byte through a count-checked pointer and keeps reading the format string until a conversion or the end is reached.

name: format_escape_sequences
description: Reads format bytes and handles doubled percent signs by writing a single percent sign, passing other bytes on to helper routines until the string ends.

name: terminate_format_output
description: Passes the end-of-output marker to the output helper, marking the end of the format string.

name: format_signed_integer
description: Writes a leading minus sign into the buffer when the value is negative and converts the magnitude through a helper. It returns the number of characters written, or zero when the buffer is too small.

name: format_signed_from_frame
description: Frame-based variant of the signed integer conversion: it writes a minus sign for a negative value and converts the magnitude through a helper, returning the total length.

name: format_negative_integer
description: Writes a minus sign and converts the negated value through a helper, returning the total number of characters written.

name: shift_global_variable_left
description: Returns a global variable shifted left by three bits and performs no other operation.

name: call_with_value_twice
description: Passes its single argument to another routine twice, as both parameters, and returns without further work.

name: find_node_by_distance
description: Walks a linked list of nodes from a global head, moving by the requested distance and updating a global counter. It returns the selected node, or null when the distance is below one or the list runs out.

name: call_with_second_repeated
description: Calls another routine with its first argument followed by its second argument repeated, then returns without other work.

name: insert_or_update_list_node
description: Inserts a node into a list anchored by a global variable at a position derived from a global counter, or updates an existing node. It returns minus one when the requested count is below one and zero once the node is linked.

name: check_signal_and_dispatch
description: Reads the signal state for two bits, and when neither is set returns zero. Otherwise it passes fixed character codes, a line-break code and each index up to a global count to a helper routine, then returns that routine's result.

name: read_control_structure_byte
description: Checks the status bits of a control structure and, when it is usable, calls a helper to obtain a value and updates the structure's status bits. It returns the helper's value, or minus one on error conditions.

name: write_byte_with_retry
description: Writes a byte from its first argument into a buffer tracked by a state byte and a count field, updating the buffer position and counter. It retries through a recursive call when the counter underflows and sets status bits from the result.

name: reset_target_flags
description: Returns zero immediately when the structure already has a target and no reset flag is set. Otherwise it calls a helper with a global pointer, stores the result in two fields, clears the state flag bits and counters, and records error twelve on failure.

name: copy_string_to_offset
description: Calls a helper with the first argument to find an offset, then copies a NUL-terminated string from the second argument to that offset in memory, and returns the first argument.

name: copy_string_to_buffer
description: Copies bytes from a source string into a buffer at an offset found through a helper, stopping at the NUL byte or when the count runs out, writes a terminating zero and returns the first argument.

name: parse_format_conversion
description: Skips flag characters in a format string, handles an optional length modifier and a conversion character, and reads the next value through a callback. It returns zero when the value is out of range.

name: fetch_chars_into_buffer
description: Stores a pending character into an output buffer when one is set, then repeatedly calls a callback for the next character, storing each in the buffer and stopping at the end marker or when the count runs out.

name: parse_optional_sign
description: Reads an optional plus or minus sign through a callback and records it as a sign multiplier, then examines the next character for a numeric digit.

name: parse_octal_digits
description: Accumulates octal digits read through a callback into a value. When the current character is not an octal digit it stores that character in the output and returns zero.

name: accumulate_octal_value
description: Accumulates octal digits into a value through a callback, stopping at the first non-octal character, and stores the result through the output pointer when one is set.

name: store_parsed_result
description: Stores the parsed value and the saved position into their output pointers, and returns the consumed count plus one.

name: read_chars_into_buffer
description: Reads characters through a callback into an output buffer while the count remains and the character is not in a flagged class. It stores a terminating zero and returns the count read.

name: push_back_byte_to_stream
description: Pushes a character back onto a buffered stream, refusing it when the stream is not readable or is at its limit. It updates the stream's count and pointer and returns the character, or minus one on failure.

name: open_intuition_show_request
description: Opens the intuition library, stores its handle, and calls an auto request with fixed dimensions before calling one routine with twenty as its argument. The referenced text names the intuition library.

name: close_active_handles
description: Loops over a table of six-byte entries up to a global count, closing each entry that is non-zero and does not have flag bit four set, then calls another routine with its original parameters.

name: initialise_empty_list_header
description: Initialises an empty message list header in the given block by pointing its first word at itself plus four, clearing the next word, and pointing the last pointer back at the header.
